purpose: Bounded eight-pair follow-up pilot plan; no automatic replacement candidates are authorized.

candidates.target_description: the round copper pan hanging above the center-left cooking range
candidates.placement_rationale: The target is visible before generation and the tightened mask stays around the selected hanging pan without covering the cook.
candidates.prompt: a round brass wall clock mounted naturally on the kitchen wall, matching the warm indoor lighting

instruction_review.note: The copper pan is visible. The prior rectangle included more adjacent cookware; the revised rectangle is narrower and excludes the cook. Mask area: 3.566742% (9,350 px).
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the pan-to-clock replacement instruction.

candidates.target_description: the white range hood and honey-colored upper cabinets above the stove and counter
candidates.placement_rationale: The upper fixture group is visible before generation; the large region remains above the foreground table and fruit bowl and avoids the lower stove body.
candidates.prompt: matte navy-blue upper kitchen cabinets with a stainless-steel range hood, realistic residential interior photograph

instruction_review.note: The prior [95,75,415,315] bbox covered 29.296875% and did not satisfy large_over_30pct. Extending its lower edge by 8 px within the same backsplash/upper-fixture context yields 30.273438%, stays above the foreground bowl, and preserves the intended target and quota.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the upper-cabinet/range-hood replacement.

candidates.target_description: the open ceiling area above the living room for a crystal chandelier
candidates.placement_rationale: The living room ceiling is flat and visually clear; the revised 30.27% mask covers the ceiling plane up to y=155, clearing the ceiling-wall junction (y>=173) and furniture, but has minor localized boundary contact of ~3-4 px depth with the left curtain valance apex at x in [12, 25].
candidates.prompt: an elegant crystal chandelier hanging from the living room ceiling, warm interior illumination matching the residential lighting

instruction_review.note: The ceiling provides an open upper support plane. The mask bbox is tightened to [0, 0, 512, 155] (30.273438%, strictly preserving large_over_30pct) and clears the ceiling-wall line (y>=173) and living room furniture. Optical pixel inspection confirms localized boundary contact at y=155 with the highest ornamental curve of the left curtain valance across x in [12, 25] (contact depth ~3-4 px from fold apex y~151). This minor boundary contact is registered explicitly for human review; walls, paintings, and furniture remain completely outside the mask.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve proposed candidate substitution of IND_COCO_SDXL_041 (living room ceiling chandelier) replacing blocked candidate IND_COCO_SDXL_001, accepting the minor localized boundary contact with curtain valance apex at x in [12, 25], y=155.

candidates.target_description: the foreground forested rocky headland, cliff base, offshore sea stack rocks, and pine canopy occupying the lower-right quadrant
candidates.placement_rationale: The foreground headland, cliff base, offshore rocks, and pine trees are identified for removal. The axis-aligned rectangular mask [190, 305, 512, 512] (25.43%) envelops the headland landform, offshore rocks, and pine canopy. Because the bay is concave, this rectangular mask unavoidably encompasses bay water (x=190..340, y=305..340) and the base of the white hotel and hillside houses on the right shoreline (x=440..512, y=305..335), which will be infilled along with the headland. Sky, distant horizon, and main beach remain outside the mask.
candidates.prompt: open sea and distant coastline continuing naturally through the removed foreground headland, photorealistic sunset landscape

instruction_review.note: Option A [190, 305, 512, 512] (25.426483%, medium_10_to_30pct) is the proposed plan: it envelops 100% of the registered headland, pine canopy (y>=308), and offshore rocks (x>=190). Due to the concave diagonal shoreline, an axis-aligned bbox unavoidably captures cove water and right-shoreline hotel/houses (x in [440, 512], y in [305, 335]), which will be infilled/regenerated along with the headland. Option B ([220, 340, 512, 512], 19.158936%) is documented for reference only and DOES NOT satisfy the registered full headland removal: it severs pine crowns (y in [308, 340]) and leaves offshore rocks (x in [190, 220]) stranded in the sea, which would fail Content QC for full removal. If the user selects Option B, the target definition and QC criteria must be re-registered.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve proposed Option A mask [190, 305, 512, 512] for full headland removal (accepting infill of right-shoreline hotel/town edge); or reject Option A and re-register target/criteria under Option B.

instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve or revise the suitcase size and placement.

candidates.placement_rationale: The sky region is visually unobstructed and supports a small airborne object without altering the monument text or sculpture.

instruction_review.note: The registered region is open sky and does not cover the monument, inscription, or sculpture.

candidates.target_description: the visible vertical shaft of the abstract aluminium sculpture column 'Tower Song' by Ted Bieler, cropped at upper and lower canvas boundaries
candidates.placement_rationale: The abstract aluminium sculpture column is an isolated vertical structure. The full-height mask [170, 0, 380, 512] (41.02%) encloses the visible shaft from top to bottom (y=0..512). Because the column width is ~110 px, the 210 px mask width unavoidably encompasses background lawn, river, riverside railing, and background trees within x in [170, 380], which carries the risk of background alteration by inpainting. Outside x in [170, 380], the scene is preserved by compositing.
candidates.prompt: the visible shaft of a classical fluted Greco-Roman marble column standing naturally in the public park, realistic outdoor daylight and weathered stone texture

instruction_review.note: The candidate completely eliminates the intertwining child-adult limbs confound of IND_COMMONS_SDXL_002. The sculpture is vertically cropped by both upper and lower image boundaries, so the instruction targets the visible shaft. The mask (41.015625%, large_over_30pct) encloses the visible column but spans x=170..380, so adjacent background trees, river, and railing inside that strip carry inpainting alteration risk. Areas outside x=170..380 are preserved.
instruction_review.human_decision_required: Approve candidate substitution of IND_COMMONS_SDXL_003 replacing IND_COMMONS_SDXL_002, or retain candidate 002 with explicit confound risk acceptance.
